title: Shared building blocks of the pharmaceutical profile pharma.v1

subject.description: Subject identifier, 32 bytes hexadecimal - the same format as the subj field in the entry.

timestamp.description: Point in time in the real world, RFC 3339 with time zone.

party.description: Party involved. Names of natural persons do not belong in here; the profile knows only operations (spec Sec.11).

quantity.description: Quantity with a unit per UN/CEFACT Recommendation 20, e.g. KGM, GRM, LTR, H87 (pieces).

product.description: A batch, intermediate, API or finished-dosage-form unit (spec Sec.5, Sec.10).

ndc.description: US National Drug Code, optional alongside gtin - DSCSA's own barcode encodes a GTIN derived from the NDC.

serial.description: The individual unit's printed/scanned serial number. Distinct from, and never used to derive, the entry's subject ID (spec Sec.11, OWM-9 A10) - only meaningful at stage finished_product, instance level.

expiry.description: Expiry date, or a starting-material/intermediate's retest date - both answer 'how long is this batch usable'.

stage.description: Which regulatory regime governs this entry: ICH Q7 for the first three, DSCSA/FMD once finished_product is reached (spec Sec.5).

controlled_substance_schedule.description: DEA schedule, absent for an uncontrolled drug. Flags the additional ARCOS/Form 222 regime (spec Sec.5, Sec.12).

coa_ref.description: Reference to the Certificate of Analysis for this batch, held off-chain.

item.description: Reference to another subject, optionally with quantity and goods details.
